issue.body:
Part of #9471.

### Module Name

`lib.hm.services`

### Requested Feature

Add small, opt-in helpers for common service wiring patterns.

Potential helpers:

- cross-platform service helper for modules that emit both
  `systemd.user.services.<name>` and `launchd.agents.<name>` from same command
  and environment
- graphical-session unit helper for Linux services that repeat
  `After`/`PartOf`/`WantedBy` target wiring
- restart-trigger helper that ties generated config files to
  `X-Restart-Triggers` with correct guards

Sketch:

```nix
# configFile = generated settings file (e.g. iniFormat.generate ...)
lib.hm.services.mkCrossPlatformService {
  name = "flameshot";
  description = "Flameshot screenshot tool";
  command = lib.getExe cfg.package;
  restartOnFailure = true;   # systemd Restart=on-abort / launchd KeepAlive.Crashed
  graphical = true;          # systemd graphical-session plumbing /
                             # launchd ProcessType = "Interactive"
  environment = { ... };
  restartTriggers = [ configFile.source ];
  # per-platform overrides for semantics that don't map 1:1:
  systemd = { ... };
  launchd = { ... };
}
```

Exact API should stay open. Split helpers may be better than one large helper:
graphical-session wiring, restart triggers, and systemd/launchd parity have
different risk profiles.

Expected behavior:

- cross-platform helper emits systemd units on Linux and launchd agents on
  Darwin, with explicit per-platform override attrs
- Linux-only usage can still share graphical-session and restart-trigger
  helpers without pretending launchd support exists
- `graphical = true` or equivalent covers common `After`/`PartOf`/`WantedBy`
  bundle and supports configurable targets
- `restartTriggers` accepts generated file sources and keeps guards aligned
  with generated config files
- helpers remain compatible with existing `modules/services-modular`
  direction

Explicit `systemd`/`launchd` overrides should be required for anything that
does not map cleanly. Helper must not imply false parity.

### Current Limitations

Three repeated patterns show up across service modules:

1. Cross-platform duplication

19 modules currently define both `systemd.user.services` and `launchd.agents`.
This includes at least these service modules: `colima`, `emacs`, `espanso`,
`exo`, `flameshot`, `git-sync`, `glance`, `imapnotify`, `nix-gc`, `ollama`,
`proton-pass-agent`, `ssh-agent`, `syncthing`, `tldr-update`, and
`yubikey-agent`.

These branches often duplicate command construction, environment handling,
restart/keepalive behavior, and generated config references.

2. Graphical-session boilerplate

Local grep survey found:

- 60 files set `PartOf = [ "graphical-session.target" ]`
- 46 files set `After = [ "graphical-session.target" ]`
- 72 files set `WantedBy = [ "graphical-session.target" ]`

(file counts for the exact single-element pattern under `modules/`; looser
patterns and multi-element lists find more)

Some modules expose a target option, some hard-code `graphical-session.target`,
and some hand-roll `config.wayland.systemd.target` support.

3. Restart-trigger drift

26 program/service modules define `X-Restart-Triggers`. Generated config files
and restart triggers are usually wired separately, so later settings additions
can miss restart behavior.

### Additional Context

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Helper(s) implemented in `modules/lib/`, exposed via
      `lib.hm.services`
- [ ] 2-3 cross-platform services migrated as proof (for example
      `flameshot`, `git-sync`, `imapnotify`),
      zero diff in generated units/agents
- [ ] 3-5 Linux graphical services migrated via the preset
- [ ] Platform-gated tests per AGENTS.md conventions
      (`lib.optionalAttrs` in test `default.nix`, darwinScrublist entries
      where needed)
- [ ] News entry

Related upstream issues:

- #3703: some service modules do not expose a `systemdTarget` option
- #5506: `swayosd` should expose `systemdTarget`
- #8034: systemd user services sometimes start without expected environment

These are adjacent target/environment issues, not direct duplicates of a
shared helper proposal.

Risks:

- One broad service factory can become too magical. Prefer small helpers where
  possible.
- systemd and launchd semantics differ. Per-platform overrides are mandatory.
- Existing `home.services` modular-service work may already cover part of this
  problem; new helpers should reuse or align with it.
issue.title: [Feature Request] Add lib.hm.services helpers for repeated service wiring
